# muumuu_dns_records (Data Source)

Lists the DNS records of a domain that uses Muumuu DNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "muumuu_dns_records" "mx" {
  domain_id = data.muumuu_domain.example.id
  type      = "MX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain (e.g. `MU00000001`).

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) Only return records with this FQDN.
- `type` (String) Only return records of this type.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) The DNS records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the record without a trailing dot.
- `id` (String) The ID of the DNS record.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of `MX` and `SRV` records.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL in seconds.
- `type` (String) The record type.
- `value` (String) The record value.
